Key Governance Features of Our Executive Compensation Program
We are committed to executive compensation practices that are intended to align the interests of our executives and shareholders:

A significant portion of our NEOs' compensation is at-risk variable compensation. Annual and long-term cash incentives and a significant portion of equity compensation are tied to performance measures.
Variable compensation is based on more than one measure to balance incentives.
Our policies provide for the adjustment or recovery of compensation in certain circumstances, including financial restatements and employee misconduct.
All our variable compensation plans have caps on plan formulas.
We have below-average run rates for equity compensation, as compared to the companies in the S&P 500 Index and the S&P 500 Food, Beverage & Tobacco Index.
Our Compensation and Talent Development Committee ("C&TD Committee") uses tally sheets when making individual compensation decisions for our NEOs.
Perquisites represent less than 1% of our NEOs' compensation.
Nine of our 10 director nominees are independent
Five of our independent directors have been added since the beginning of 2021
All New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") required Board committees consist solely of independent directors
Executive sessions of independent directors at each meeting
Directors elected by majority voting, except in contested elections
Resignation policy for directors who fail to receive majority support in an uncontested election
